info.title: Huntress CTF 2026 Game Master
info.description: Authenticated player API for listing, starting, resuming, downloading, checking, and submitting generic challenge attempts. Every selected active compounding challenge returns a questions array aligned one-for-one with answer_ids; each question names its artifact, exact objective, normalization, and answer_format without exposing the private expected value.

get.summary: List challenges, inspect an attempt, download an assigned artifact, or read this API description.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: List one release day (0 = welcome lane) instead of the smart default.

parameters.name: lane
parameters.description: List one lane instead of the smart default.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: List every released challenge instead of the smart default.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: List challenges whose id contains this text.

200.description: JSON result, including the public questions contract for a selected challenge, or private artifact bytes when op is artifact.

409.description: Attempt state conflict. Selected-challenge conflicts such as start_required still include the public questions contract.

post.summary: Start or resume an attempt, submit answers, or retry an expired attempt.

200.description: Attempt state, download assignment, or answer result, including the public questions contract.

409.description: Attempt state conflict. prerequisite_required and start_required responses retain the public questions contract.
